thesis: The page is one flat Albuquerque roof on one day: the sun crosses it east to west as you scroll, and every section's stepped parapet casts the shadow it would really cast, so the reader learns where panels can sit before anyone calls.

signature.name: Parapet Shadow Clock
signature.summary: One scroll var --sun (east 0, noon .5, west 1) moves a gold sun disc along a margin arc; every section's stepped parapet top edge (.parapet clip-path, 3 steps) casts a clay shadow wedge sized height x cot(altitude). Hero: the sun disc is the photo mask behind a drawn parapet (Dec 21 31.5deg, 1.63x wedge). Story: top-down roof plan whose shadow polygon redraws over 4 stops and dims panel rows. Calculator: same primitive at the reader's height. Cards: wedges follow --sun. Footer: sunset, longest wedge. Reduced motion: fixed noon.

palette.family: Parapet Clay + Canale Turquoise + Noon Gold + Umber

layoutMoves: stepped parapet top edge on every band, step heights vary per section
12-col grid with a right sky margin column carrying the sun arc at >=1100px
top-down SVG roof plan as the pinned story instead of photos
giant slab multipliers 1.63x / 0.70x / 0.21x as section type
clay field hero with a circle-masked photo bleeding off the right edge

motion.intro: Sun disc (photo mask) rises 18% into place, photo brightens .8->1 over 900ms; hero shadow wedge grows from the parapet 520ms; h1 never hidden.
stories: cast: pinned top-down roof plan, --sun scrubs 4 stops, shadow polygon morphs and panel rows inside it dim and slide back
draw: page-wide --sun moves the sun along the margin arc and sets every card's parapet wedge length
motion.hover: parapet step lifts 4px and its wedge lengthens 12% in 200ms; links get a hairline scaleX underline
